name: dc-street-trees
license: CC BY 4.0 (District of Columbia, via opendata.dc.gov)
command: data raw csv "https://opendata.dc.gov/api/download/v1/items/f6c3c04113944f23a7993f2e603abaf2/csv?layers=0" urban-forestry-street-trees --license "CC BY 4.0" --about "Urban Forestry Street Trees: Urban Forestry Division managed trees and tree locations." --page https://opendata.dc.gov/datasets/f6c3c04113944f23a7993f2e603abaf2
data template raw/urban-forestry-street-trees dc-street-trees --question "What kind of tree stands at {VICINITY}?" --answer "{CMMN_NM} ({SCI_NM}), in {CONDITION} condition." --skip 0 --limit 300

sources.about: Urban Forestry Street Trees: Urban Forestry Division managed trees and tree locations.

about: 300 questions and answers made from Washington DC's street-tree inventory: which tree stands at an address, its common and scientific name, and its condition. Made with a template from a table on DC Open Data, so every answer is a fact from the table. Not split yet: that is step 2.
